title: Pullback naturality of the termwise hypercohomology spectral sequence
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $K^\bullet$ and $L^\bullet$ be bounded-below complexes of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on $X$ and $Y$, and let $u:f^{-1}K^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ be a morphism of complexes [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For the hypercohomology spectral sequences [thm-sp-if-e1] of the global-sections functors on $X$ and $Y$, indexed as $E_1^{p,q}(X,K)=H^p(X_{\Et},K^q)$ and $E_1^{p,q}(Y,L)=H^p(Y_{\Et},L^q)$ with $q$ the filtration degree, the pair $(f,u)$ induces a morphism of spectral sequences [def-sp-spectral-sequence]. Its $E_1^{p,q}$ map is $H^p(X_{\Et},K^q)\xrightarrow{f^*}H^p(Y_{\Et},f^{-1}K^q)\xrightarrow{H^p(u^q)}H^p(Y_{\Et},L^q)$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Its abutment map is the canonical map $H^n(X_{\Et},K^\bullet)\to H^n(Y_{\Et},L^\bullet)$ on derived global sections [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], and it preserves the finite decreasing filtrations by $q$ and commutes with the identifications $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^qH^{p+q}$ of [thm-sp-if-e1]. These spectral-sequence and abutment maps are identity maps when $(f,u)$ is the identity, and compose for successive pairs $(f,u)$ after the canonical identification of composite inverse images [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition].

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EZM (lemma-colimit-variant-complexes), proof, natural maps implicit in the two spectral sequences; derived.tex Lemma Tag 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor); the functorial filtered-complex construction is thm-sp-spectral-object-yields

proof.text: Choose Cartan--Eilenberg resolutions $I_K$ and $J_L$. Put $F=f^{-1}$, which is exact by [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-exact], and let $\phi:F(I_K)\to J_L$ be the lift of $u$ supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-eilenberg-functorial]. The filtered complexes whose spectral sequences occur in [thm-sp-if-e1] are $\Gamma(X,\operatorname{Tot} I_K)$ and $\Gamma(Y,\operatorname{Tot} J_L)$. The termwise unit from [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] gives $\Gamma(X,\operatorname{Tot} I_K)\to\Gamma(X,f_*f^{-1}\operatorname{Tot} I_K)=\Gamma(Y,f^{-1}\operatorname{Tot} I_K)$, and then $\Gamma(Y,\operatorname{Tot}\phi)$ gives a map to $\Gamma(Y,\operatorname{Tot}J_L)$. Both maps preserve the filtration by $q$ because they are termwise maps of the double complexes. Applying (c) of [thm-sp-spectral-object-yields] and the identifications of [thm-sp-if-e1] produces the required morphism of spectral sequences.

source.place: Lemma Tag 015J and Remark Tag 015K; filtered-complex functoriality

proof.text: For each $q$, the $q$-th row of a Cartan--Eilenberg resolution is an injective resolution of $K^q$ by [thm-sp-if-e1], and a bounded-below complex of injectives is K-injective by [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. Thus the $q$-graded piece of the global-section map in step 1 is $\Gamma(X,I^q)\to\Gamma(Y,f^{-1}I^q)\to\Gamma(Y,J^q)$. In the pullback recipe [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], choose a K-injective resolution $r:f^{-1}I^q\to J'$ and a map $\psi:J'\to J^q$ such that $\psi\circ r$ is homotopic to the row map; this is possible because $J^q$ is K-injective by [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions]. The map $\psi$ is a lift of $u^q$ in the sense of $H^p(\phi)$ in [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]. Therefore the $E_1^{p,q}$ map is $H^p(u^q)\circ f^*$, with the displayed source and target identified by [thm-sp-if-e1] and [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EZM, proof via the two spectral sequences

proof.text: By (b) and (c) of [thm-sp-spectral-object-yields] and [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], the abutment is derived global sections, the map is the canonical map on $H^n$, the finite filtration is preserved, and the identifications $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^qH^{p+q}$ commute. For identity pairs this construction is the identity by the unit identity in [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]. For successive pairs $(f,u)$ and $(g,v)$, the composite of the maps from step 1 is, by naturality of the unit $\eta_g$ and clause 2 of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], the map constructed for the composite pair using the lift $\psi\circ g^{-1}\phi\circ c^{-1}$. The abutment map is independent of the chosen lift because two lifts into the K-injective total complex agree up to homotopy after the quasi-isomorphism $f^{-1}K\to f^{-1}\operatorname{Tot}I_K$. Finally, a morphism of spectral sequences is determined from its $E_1$ map by $E_{r+1}=H(E_r)$ in [def-sp-spectral-sequence], so identity and composition on every $E_r$ follow from step 2 and clauses 3--4 of [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial] applied to the sheaves $K^q$.
